 THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR FINAL HEARING, THIS DAY, THE COURT DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 JUDGMENT

The present appeal is filed by the appellant/claimant challenging the judgment and award dated 28.01.2012 in MVC.No.4396/2010 passed by the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, XX Addl. Judge & XVIII ACMM, Bangalore (ACMM-18), for seeking enhancement of compensation.

entities.text: Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, XX Addl. Judge & XVIII ACMM, Bangalore (ACMM-18)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The factum of accident is not in dispute.

3. Heard the arguments from both sides and perused the records.
4.
The Tribunal has awarded global compensation of Rs.10,000/- along with interest at the rate of 6% per annum from the date of petition till the date of NC: 2023:KHC:21014 deposit.
The compensation amount awarded by the Tribunal is found to be meager one.
5. From the evidence on record, it is proved that the claimant had sustained fracture of left radial head fracture of L3 and L4 vertebras and he sustained abrasion over left elbow.
The said injuries are grievous in nature.
The claimant was admitted to the hospital as inpatient for a period of two days.
Therefore, the global compensation of Rs.10,000/- awarded by the Tribunal is found to be on the lesser side.

6. Therefore, considering the overall facts and circumstances and nature of injuries sustained, it is just and proper to enhance the compensation by another sum of Rs.50,000/- in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal.
